literal_meaning: যমের ঘৃণা বা অরুচি (Yama's distaste or aversion)
figurative_meaning_bn: যে সহজে মরে না; এমন দুষ্ট লোক যে যমেও ছুঁতে ঘেন্না করে; অবজ্ঞাসূচক উক্তি
figurative_meaning_en: Someone who does not die easily; a mischievous person so wicked that even Yama feels disgusted to touch them; a contemptuous remark
similar_in_english: Even the devil wouldn't have him
example_sentences_in_bangla: ও যমের অরুচি, কতবার বিপদে পড়েও বেঁচে গেছে।
এই দুষ্টু ছেলেটা যমের অরুচি হয়ে গেছে, কেউ তাকে সামলাতে পারে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He's Yama's distaste; he's survived so many dangers without dying.
This naughty boy has become Yama's aversion; no one can handle him.
history: References the Hindu god Yama, the lord of death, from ancient mythological texts like the Puranas, symbolizing immortality or extreme naughtiness in Bengali folklore.
note: The idiom draws from Hindu beliefs prevalent in Bengali culture, often used humorously or derogatorily.
